idea-plugin.name: Floorplan
idea-plugin.description:
See what your AI agents are doing. Floorplan draws the open project as a cozy pixel-art house: themed rooms for each aspect of the code (a kitchen for factories, a living room for entry points, a lab for tests...) and labelled furniture for its main files. Your agent can design the house itself through the floorplan MCP tools. Each agent running in JetBrains Air is a character that walks to the files it reads and edits.

A heads-up display (HUD) shows the agent's model, effort, tokens, context usage and cost, plus its plan as a quest log. Use Wrap my agents once so that Air runs its agents through the Floorplan tap.

Install into both the frontend and the backend IDE (split mode).
